name: analyze_papers
description: Extracts all 10 literature review categories (Architecture, Reasoning, Data, MITRE, Metrics, Failures, Motivation, Baselines, IO Specs, Reproducibility) from an AI security paper PDF.

arguments.name: filepath
arguments.description: Absolute or relative path to the PDF file.

execute.prompt: Run the full extraction pipeline on the PDF at {filepath}. Execute Ingestor -> Parallel Analysis (Architect, Analyst, Critic) -> Compiler. Return the final markdown file path.
